Name: (CP) Better NPC Shop by Luna
Author: LunaGlaze
Description:
Do you think friends should give each other a discounted price? Whether it's Pierre or other villagers, the price at which they sell goods to players will never change, even if your friendship has already accumulated ten hearts.
Do you think the shops of the villagers in Stardew Valley sell too few things, without what you really need or lack? Why can't Pierre sell Oak Resin for me to make Keg? Why does Marnie not sell animal products even though she has her own ranch?
[size=4][b]It's time to change this situation now![/b][/size]
_______________________________

[b][size=3]Regarding the price|关于价格:[/size][/b]
Now, if you have enough love with the villagers, they will offer you discounts.
现在，如果你与村民有着足够的爱心，他们会为你打折。
[b]Using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url], you can freely set whether they offer you a discount or the extent of the discount.
使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用模组配置菜单[/url]，你可以自由设置他们是否为你打折，或者打折的幅度是多少。[/b]
By default|默认配置：
10% discount at 3 hearts
3心打九折
25% discount at 6 hearts
6心打七五折
40% discount at 10 hearts
10心打六折
_______________________________

[b][size=3]Regarding goods|关于商品:[/size][/b]
Added a series of configurable adjustments to the list of items sold in village shops, mainly adding many new products. Each item can be configured separately.
添加了一系列可配置的对NPC商店出售物品列表的调整，主要是新增了很多新的商品。每一项都可以单独配置。
[b]Using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to set it.
使用[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用模组配置菜单[/url]来对其进行设置。[/b]
Including having Pierre sell Tapper products Ancient Seeds、Rare Seeds、Batteries； Let Marnie sell animal products Artisan Equipment、 Selling Auto Petter after the closure of Joja Supermarket; Let Clint sell metal bars, let Dwarf sell Geode, let Volcano Dwarf sell Cinder Shard and Dragon Tooth, and so on...
包括让皮埃尔出售树液采集器产物、上古种子、稀有种子和电池组；让玛妮出售动物产品、工匠机器、在Joja超市倒闭后出售自动抚摸机；让克林特出售金属条、让矮人出售晶球、让火山矮人出售火山晶石和龙牙等等……
You can freely turn on any of them, turn them all on, or turn them off.
你可以自由地开启其中的任意一项、全部开启，或是将其关闭。
_______________________________

[b][size=3]Affected|作用范围:[/size][/b]
All normal vanilla shops|所有普通的原版NPC商店
All of Pierre's festival booths(optional)|皮埃尔的所有节日摊位（可选）

[b]Please let me know which other stores you would like to support.
你还希望支持哪些商店，请告诉我。[/b]
_______________________________

[b][size=3]Compatibility|兼容性:[/size][/b]
This mod is based on the PriceModefiers of Vanilla and theoretically compatible with any mod that adds new items to Vanilla Village Store, unless these mods prohibit PriceModefiers from taking effect on their products.
这个模组是基于原版的PriceModifiers工作的，理论上兼容任何向原版NPC商店添加新物品的mod，除非这些mod禁止了PriceModifiers对其商品生效。
It is not recommended to enable the discount function based on favorability together with mods with similar functions, but the remaining part should work normally after turning off the corresponding function.
基于好感度折扣的功能不建议与具有类似功能的mod一同启用，但关闭对应功能后剩余部分应当正常工作。
->Compatible with Vegas Mid Game Automate
